gen-gf-grandstander-inter: Grandstander struts with a tall x-height and short ascenders, its constant-width lines held open. Inter is the quiet counterpart, with big counters and a smooth, tube-like line built for steady reading.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega writes like one nib, its body height nearly matching the capitals. What stands out most is the tube-like stroke and splayed c of Tilt Neon, against the visible gap in every body c.
gen-gf-grandstander-roboto-slab: Expressive and bold, Grandstander draws round letters with constant-width lines, while Roboto Slab sets a low, structured texture beneath. Grandstander shows off up top; the slab-serif stays precise, open-throated and dense below.
gen-irish-grover-gf-lexend-tera: Fun and organic, Irish Grover makes words look sturdy and large, its strokes mildly varied in thickness. Lexend Tera draws every curve in a single plotter-pen line, letters spaced like stepping stones.
gen-gf-gugi-bitter: Bitter reads grounded and dependable, its lowercase eye very large. Gugi earns its keep big and short, where lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals and terminals cut open can show off.
gen-gf-gugi-inter: Lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals gives Gugi its odd, bold stance, with terminals cut open so counters flow outward. Inter then reads smoothly, its big counters keeping paragraphs easy going.
gen-megrim-gf-montserrat-alternates: Megrim cuts angular, futuristic letters with a skyward x-height, every stroke ending in a measured, uniform thickness. Montserrat Alternates is rounder, its chalk-board lowercase crowding up toward the capital line.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa reads clean and professional, its curves broad and distinct. Snowburst One does the showing off, a stencil sheet with wide bridges, while the sans-serif body keeps stubby ascenders tidy.
gen-gf-gugi-roboto-slab: Curves that match the stems exactly, drawn at a constant line width, give Gugi its blunt, bold character. Roboto Slab handles the texture, its open throats keeping lines precise.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-lexend-zetta: Tektur gives its pipe-cleaner strokes generous terminal openings and lowercase of oddly outsized proportions. Lexend Zetta, widely tracked and cut like constant-width ribbon, is the approachable one that keeps things readable.
